title: Reservation lifecycle handshake and launch gating for new dedicated SKUs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinate cross-team gating and operational handshake for introducing three new dedicated SKUs (g5x-compact, g6y-standard, g7m-highmem) across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private customers. This ticket drives the release gating criteria, reservation lifecycle docs, billing alignment, partner enablement artifacts, and the runbook handoff for post-launch support.
acceptance_criteria: Final SKU matrix published and approved by Finance and Product
Reservation lifecycle doc (create/modify/cancel/transfer) published in Confluence with API examples
Billing reconciliation flow validated with Billing Eng and Finance in a staging run
Launch gating checklist signed off by Engineering, SRE, Security, Legal, and Sales Ops
Release notes draft prepared and scheduled for coordinated publication with console-2025.03 release

Billing reconciliation mismatch rate under 0.1% after first billing cycle

notes_risks: Risk: Quota service schema changes (ENG-7890) could slip, blocking reservation create in staging
Risk: Finance may require revised enterprise discounting which impacts pricing bands and release messaging
Risk: Console UI complexity for mixing burst vs reserved pricing could confuse customers; mitigating with simplified defaults and microcopy
Mitigation: Schedule contingency week for rework and a feature-flagged rollout for console UI
Open decision: whether to allow reservation transfers between orgs in launch (default: disabled)
